I updated the repo for the shutdowns and removals that already apply, and for the OpenAI model retirement due within 90 days. `tsc --noEmit` passes. I didn't run the tests or call any live API.

I read the vendors' official deprecation pages. The Gemini one was the fetched page, and the OpenAI one is the markdown copy of its page. I couldn't read OpenAI's Realtime beta-to-GA migration guide, so the Realtime changes are from memory of the GA interface. Please check them against that guide before shipping.

**What changed**
- **Gemini model default:** `gemini-2.0-flash` was shut down on 2026-06-01, so any call that used the default now fails. I switched it to `gemini-3.6-flash`, Google's listed replacement. This is in `ai/dispatch-email-llm.service.ts`, `ai/task-assignment-llm.service.ts` and `pm/proposal-plan-generator.service.ts`.
- **Gemini fallback model:** the doc comment's fallback example `gemini-1.5-flash` is now `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, which has no announced shutdown.
- **OpenAI Realtime (`realtime/realtime-voice.service.ts`):** the Realtime beta was removed on 2026-05-12, and the `gpt-4o-realtime-preview` models were removed on 2026-05-07. I made these changes:
  - The model is now `gpt-realtime-2.1`.
  - I removed the `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` header.
  - `session.update` now sends `type: 'realtime'` and `audio.output.voice`, instead of a top-level `voice`.
  - I renamed the audio event handler to `response.output_audio.delta`.
- **OpenAI chat model default:** `gpt-4o-mini` is being removed on 2027-01-14, which is 72 days away. The default is now `gpt-6-luna` everywhere it appeared. That covers `ai`, `assistant`, `meeting`, `market-intelligence` and `pm`. The `OPENAI_*_MODEL` environment variables still override it.
- **Chat Completions parameters:** I renamed `max_tokens` to `max_completion_tokens` in three places. OpenAI's GPT-6 migration notes say `temperature` is only accepted when reasoning effort is `none`. So I added `reasoning_effort: 'none'` to the three calls that set `temperature`.

If you set `OPENAI_MODEL` to an older model such as `gpt-4o`, `reasoning_effort` may be rejected on those three calls. Remove it there if so.

**Later deprecations, not edited**
- `gemini-2.5-flash` and `gemini-2.5-pro` start auto-routing to other models on 2026-12-01. The repo doesn't use them as defaults.
- `gpt-realtime` and `gpt-4o-realtime` are retired on 2027-01-20. The code already uses `gpt-realtime-2.1`.
- `@google/generative-ai` (`^0.24.1`) is the legacy Google SDK. I didn't confirm a retirement date for it. Gemini 3 models may need a newer SDK for some features.
- The chat calls still use Chat Completions. GPT-6 requires the Responses API for tool calling, but this code doesn't use tools, so I left it.
- I didn't check Stripe, Resend, SendGrid, Uber or Google OAuth. I only looked at OpenAI and Gemini.

Sources:
- [Gemini deprecations](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations)
- [OpenAI deprecations](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations)
- [OpenAI GPT-6 migration notes](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model)
